title: The Photograph Registry Where Unpaid Places Remember

features.name: filing-wall of forgotten properties
features.desc-on-touch: Photographs of places that owe their existence to being unpaid. Empty houses, abandoned storefronts, properties held in suspension.

features.name: image-mirror where places see themselves as debt
features.desc-on-touch: A building photographed, then corrupted to show the amount owed instead of the structure. The debt has learned to look like a place.

features.name: stacked negatives where light becomes obligation
features.desc-on-touch: Each photograph's inverse shows what the place owes. Absence and presence superimposed. Light and shadow of unpaid things.

features.name: chronometer counting backward through time-debt
features.desc-on-touch: The longer a place remains unpaid, the older the photograph becomes. Time runs backward for what is owed.

features.name: catalogue-plinth recording what was never rendered
features.desc-on-touch: Photographs of places that should exist but don't—mapped onto properties that exist but aren't paid for. The corruption loves this symmetry.

inscription: debts learn to carry images; places remember what they are owed and photograph themselves accordingly

file.name: Photographic_Debt_Registry_1988-2011.jpg
file.note: Systematic documentation of photographed properties arranged by unpaid obligations. Each image filename is a sum. Corruption: places are starting to appear in photographs of other places.

reverie.title: REVERIE — sitting on the curb of an unpaid street
narr: You and Katita sat on the kerb of a street
that owed taxes it would never pay. She held
a photograph of the same street—same angle,
same light, same curb. The photo knew what was
owed. The place forgot. She said: the archive
remembers what places are too tired to know.

exits.label: back down to the pit where debts accumulate
northward into places that photograph themselves as owed
into a corridor of images that forgot their places
into a registry where properties dream their debt-forms
